info.title: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities
info.description: The US Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency's catalog of vulnerabilities CONFIRMED to be exploited in the wild. Free, keyless, no parameters — the whole catalog is one file, republished as it changes. Roughly 1,700 entries against the several hundred thousand CVEs in existence, which is precisely why it is the useful filter.

get.summary: The entire Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog
get.description: Returns `{catalogVersion, dateReleased, count, vulnerabilities: [...]}`. Each entry has `cveID`, `vendorProject`, `product`, `vulnerabilityName`, `dateAdded`, `shortDescription`, `requiredAction`, `dueDate`, and `knownRansomwareCampaignUse` (`Known` or `Unknown`) — the last being the sharpest single field in public security data.
